body:
Part of General UI Polish (feature item 5). Many select boxes should become sliders, toggles, or other controls that fit the choice.

- Strategy filters (`choice`, `link_select` in `strategy`): Column and Closed become segmented button groups; Project, Feature and Milestone stay selects (long lists) but use the label map from task b5762697be085893.
- Settings: Dark mode stays a switch; Panel side (task 56fd25a7a57c79a) is a switch; any select in Settings becomes a switch or segmented group.
- Task detail and plan panel: agent and effort choices become segmented groups; the new-task project picker (`solace_task.projects_pick`) becomes a list of toggle chips when the project count is small, a select when it is large.
- Rank and target-date controls keep their native widgets; sliders are used where a numeric range is the choice.

**Tests:** strategy, settings and components view tests assert the new controls and that choosing them sends the same messages the selects sent.
title: ui: Replace selects with controls
